title: Traditional Dutch Pancakes
description: A classic Dutch recipe using simple ingredients to create a delicious and fluffy pancake dish. Serve warm with your favorite toppings!
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, pancake mix, eggs, milk, melted butter, sugar, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix well.
2. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
3. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture onto the pan.
4. Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
5. Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Serve warm with your favorite toppings, such as powdered sugar, fresh fruit, or whipped cream.
